lines.2: 「Good, you made it. That brings us to ninety. Now then, ladies and gentlemen, it's about time we began.」
lines.4: 「The gathering of the fan club for Erika Kiriya--our Princess.」
lines.5: 「First, the publicity unit. Please report on the Princess's exploits from last week through today.」
lines.6: 「Yes, sir. As usual, she scored a perfect hundred on every test. She's miles ahead of second place.」
lines.7: The captain was a third-year, so Fukahire was actually speaking politely.
lines.8: 「Well, she ranks first in the national practice exams too. No one at this school could hope to rival her.」
lines.9: 「Also, when she got thirsty, she sent some random boy to fetch her a drink, and she had the sports clubs carry heavy equipment for the student council.」
lines.10: 「Furthermore, she skipped several classes. She also watched a fight between two boys without stopping it because she found it entertaining.」
lines.11: 「She graciously allowed the boys' synchronized swimming club--all two members of it--to operate despite school regulations. When a teacher complained, she drove him off by declaring, 'I gave them permission, so it is fine.'」
lines.12: 「She also seems to be attending tennis-club practice. They're playing practice matches, and naturally, she is winning.」
lines.13: 「Hmm. Her absolute, self-assured dominance remains as magnificent as ever.」
lines.14: 「Listen carefully. We are a wholesome fan club. We exchange only information available to the general public, and we never intrude upon the Princess's private life.」
lines.15: 「Secret photography is out of the question, of course. Not that she's someone you could photograph without permission. Remember, even plotting it carries the death penalty.」
lines.16: ...The Princess didn't exactly have a personality everyone could love.
lines.17: But that only made her fans--male and female alike--that much more intense.
lines.18: She had become student council president in her first year. There was something about her that seized people's attention and never let go.
lines.20: I admired the Princess because she could look at something wrong and declare, without hesitation, that it was wrong.
lines.21: The fact that she could remain so completely true to herself was incredible.
lines.22: And she had the ability to back it up.
lines.23: The Princess wasn't just beautiful on the outside. Everything about her was beautiful.
lines.24: 「Next is our customary Princess photo sale. This time, we have shots from yesterday's speech in the gym! Photo unit, you got her permission for these, correct?」
lines.26: 「Oh, so you chose photos from that occasion. Very well. You caught me from my favorite angle. I'll sign one, so make it the rare edition.」
lines.29: 「Don't casually start swooning over the photographer.」
lines.31: The photographer wasn't much of a talker.
lines.32: 「Regular copies are five hundred yen. The rare one... has the sort of signature where she scribbled something in hiragana, so bidding starts at ten thousand. The last signed one with a cat doodle went for a hundred thousand, though.」
lines.33: 「As always, the proceeds will go toward maintaining the club.」
lines.36: 「If I don't spend the money from my part-time job on something like this, what else would I spend it on?!」
lines.37: I could think of plenty of things... but I wanted a copy too.
lines.38: While I was thinking that, the pictures sold at a frightening pace.
lines.43: We'd spoken at the same time.
lines.44: 「All right, all right, only one copy remains. Per club rules, you two will settle this with a quiz.」
lines.45: 「You're in class 2-C, aren't you? You're already in the same class as the Princess. Surely you can let me have the photo.」
lines.46: 「That's got nothing to do with this.」
lines.48: The guy fixed me with a murderous glare.
lines.50: The Princess might intimidate me, but did he really think some guy's glare would scare me off?
lines.51: 「...Very well. We'll settle it with the quiz. Competition makes my heart race.」
lines.52: 「Question: other than Yoshimi Sato, whom does the Princess trust?」
lines.53: 「Hmm. A difficult one... Her parents, perhaps?」
lines.56: 「...Even if it was only a quiz, I cannot believe I lost!」
lines.58: 「Damn it... I truly have a difficult personality. Losing a single quiz has made me furious.」
lines.59: 「You don't have to take it that hard.」
